name: Q1 早答え：答えている間の知らせに正解の番号を入れてしまう（門1）
from: topic: q ? { q: q.q, choices: q.choices.slice() } : null,
to: topic: q ? { q: q.q, choices: q.choices.slice(), correct: q.correct } : null,

from: topic: q ? { q: q.q, unit: q.unit } : null,
to: topic: q ? { q: q.q, unit: q.unit, answer: q.answer } : null,
expect: 正解の数が届いていない

from: a.forEach(function (q) { if (out.length < RULES.NEAR.ROUNDS && !tables[q.table || q.q]) { tables[q.table || q.q] = true; out.push(q); } });
